notes.learnings: Lower-confidence EMA stack trades on low-float alts like ADA can still be profitable but require patience — 7 hours is a long hold for a 15-min cadence system. Consider whether a tighter initial TP target makes more sense when confidence is below 90 to lock in gains before mean-reversion pressure builds.
